L54: 摘要：
L55: 在历史发展过程中，有些人物与事件会被有意或无意地遮蔽，这在敦煌文献的早期流散过程中表现得较为显著。例如，斯坦因攫取敦煌文献早于伯希和，但其被国人知晓要晚得多。又如1907年5月升允阻止斯坦因敦煌考古的电文，1912年8月前拍摄敦煌石窟遗迹的恩裕如，以及1921年参观俄藏敦煌文献的“天我”等。这些在敦煌学学术史上看似细枝末节的边缘人与事被历史消音的原因，一方面是其所处时代对敦煌石室文献价值与意义的理解与认知局限所致，另一方面也与相关当事人的曲意遮蔽有关，或者是当事人与敦煌学关系较为疏离，等等。
L56: 
L57: 关键词： 故事; 传播; 遮蔽; 消音; 敦煌文献;

L59: Abstract：
L60: During the development of the social,someone and something have been covered intended or unintended,such phenomenon was outstanding in the early history of Dunhuang documents.For example,Stein grasped substantial haul of Dunhuang scrolls before Pelliot,but it was known by the public after Pelliot.
L61: The cable from Sheng Yun which obstructed Stein from excavating at Dunhuang in May 1907,En Yuru who took pictures of Dunhuang Caves before August 1912,and Tian wo who visited the Dunhuang documents collected By Soviet Union,etc..
L62: Such marginal people and events which were been silenced,one reason was that the perception on values and significance of the Dunhuang caves and documents was restricted,the other reason was that the concerned person do it intentionally,or they are relatively distant from Dunhuang Academic.
L63: KeyWords： story; dissemination; cover; silencing phenomenon; Dunhuang documents;
